description: A directive binds `'[tabindex]': 'order()'` over `order()` returning `0`, and a component of another file extends `mixinOrder(PctAvatarBase)`, a mixin another package exports, and 2.4.3 keeps resting on the scan. A base no name resolves can be any class, one that overrides the method too: every value read off a member is refused.
